tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa'i rnam grangs brjod pa bdud las rgyal byed ces bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa'i rnam grangs brjod pa bdud las rgyal byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs

bsdus pa'i rnam grangs brjod pa bdud las rgyal byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ na mo badz+ra bhai ra wa ye/ 'dir 'jigs byed bdud las rnam rgyal du grags pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa zhig brjod par bya ste/ bsdus pa byed tshul la rgya gzhung nas gzhal yas khang yod med gnyis 'byung ba ltar/ bod kyi mkhas pas mdzad pa la yang de gnyis 'dug cing*/ /'on kyang lā li ta'i bzhed pa ni gzhal yas khang yod pa'i lugs so/ /gzhal yas khang yod pa'i phyogs la'ang bskyed tshul mi 'dra ba rgya gzhung dang bod kyi mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis ka nas 'byung yang*/ /'dir paṇa chen gong ma dang cang 'gya zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs las gzhal yas khang bskyed tshul bsdus pa mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brang nas 'chad pa la/ yo byad dgos pa rnams tshogs par byas te/ /rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ nang mchod byin rlabs rgyas pa ni bcu gsum ma ltar dang*/ bsdu na/ gnyis las/ dang po ni/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ āḥlas mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dbus dang phyogs bzhir bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ las sha lnga go ku da ha nas mtshan pa mtshams bzhi dang dgus laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ baṃ las bdud rtsi lnga bi ra shu ma mus mtshan pa/ /de dag gi steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs par gyur/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rlung la phog /rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ /yi ge gsum gyi 'od zer gyis sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams spyan drangs nas yi ge gsum la thim pas thod par lhung nas zhu bas sbyangs rtogs spar gsum byas par gyur/

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ paṇa chen gyi der bsdu na/ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod par bshad/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab tshul bsdus pa yod kyang bcu gsum ma ltar byas na legs/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi khams mu med pa gsal bar byas/ /de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang rig pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed bla ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ /'od zer rang gi snying khar thim/ /gang gi drin gyi bde chen gnas/ /skad cig gis ni thob 'gyur ba/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /gzugs mchog mchog tu drag po che/ /dpa' bo mchog gi spyod yul can/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes sam/ bsdu na/ na mo gu ru badz+ra bhai ra wa ya bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ gi 'od zer las byung ba'i tsa rtsi ka dkar mo/ /phag mo sngon mo/ /dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ /gau ri ljang khu rnams phyag na mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs pa rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ /oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥha oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ wi kṛ tā na na duṣ+taṃ sa twa da ma ka gaḥgaḥgaḥ oṃ ku mā ra rū bi ṇe dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥha he phaṭa/ oṃ dīb+ta lo tsa na wi kṛ tā na na ma hā a ṭ+ṭa ṭ+ṭa hā sa na di ni dīp+ta ya swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nai wid+yā āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ mchod lha bsdu na/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyi mchod par gyur/ ces bya/ sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bya/ /skyes shing byung ba rnams ni bsam/ /mi byed par yang spyan sngar brjod/ /de bzhin bsod nams rjes yi rang*/ /bdag gis bder 'gro yongs su bsngo/

/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis dgrol/ /byang chub gnas la dgod par bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /de sras lam gyur sbyin sogs tshul/ /sku gsum ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /rab tu dang bas bsten par bgyi/ /zhes pas bdun rnam dag bya/ bsdus pa la rigs lnga'i sdom bzung mi dgos/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig /ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms te bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog /de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ rang dang tshogs zhing gi lha dang de dag las gzhan pa'i chos thams cad brten nas btags pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtag chad la sogs pa mtha' bzhi dang bral ba rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur/ ces pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags shing 'chi ba chos sku'i lam 'khyer bsgom/ 'di'i rgya gzhung dag na gzhal yas khang gi skor bsdus shing*/ /'dir yang gzhal yas khang bsdus te bsgom pa la paṇa chen rin po ches 'byung bzhi bsgom par ma bshad cing*/ cang 'gya zhabs kyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa las 'byung bzhi bsdus nas bskyed pa ltar byas na/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ baṃ las byung ba'i 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rab gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi rol tu gtum drag la sogs pa dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su hūṃ las byung ba'i chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma'i lte bar hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/

'dir paṇa chen gyi der dur khrod sngar ltar bskyed par mdzad la/ cang 'gya zhabs kyi bsdus pa der bskyed pa'i skabs 'dir dur khrod kyi gsal kha mi snang yang*/ nyer bsdu la dur khrod 'byung*/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag la cung zad dmar pa'i mdog can gyi steng du a yig dang po las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ dhiḥs mtshan pa'i bar ram/ yang na/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa/ zhes cang 'gya zhabs kyis bshad pa ltar ram/ gang ltar yang*/ de las 'od zer 'phraus bde bar gsheg pa thams cad spyan drangs/ dhīḥl thim de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa sku mdog ser po yid tsam khros pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon gyi glegs bam thugs kar bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar āḥlas byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ zhes bar do longs sku'i lam khyer bsgoms/ bsdu na/ 'jam dpal ser po g.yas ral gri dang g.yon glegs bam 'dzin pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes byar rung ste rgya gzhung 'ga' las kyang de bzhin du bshad/ gang byas kyang*/ de'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rnam snang la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ rdo rje rnon po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'i khro bo dang*/ sems ma rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i rig ma rnams spyan drangs/ zhes pa'am/ cang 'gyas phyogs bcu nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang rig pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ zhes bshad de gang rung gis cho ga gang yin kyang*/

'jam dpal dang bcas pa nyi ma la zhugs pa las 'od zer gyis dpag tshad stong phrag brgyar khyab pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de'i steng du hūṃ yig mthing kha 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang rig pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ hūṃ la zhugs pa las khro bo'i rdo rje kha dog nag po rtse dgu pa rwa shin tu gdeng pa/ 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa lte ba la hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de las rdo rje phra mo'i gzugs spros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro ba dang rig pa'i tshogs rnams spros te/ nam mkha'i khams thams da til gyi gang bu bzhin du gang ba nyi ma la gnas pas/ /sems can rnams smin par byas nas rdo rje 'jigs byed thob par byas pa dang lhan cig tu 'dus nas rdo rje la thim par gyur/ zhes sam/ bsdu na cang 'gyas nyi ma la zhugs pa las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ yig mthing kha de las 'od zer 'phraus/ sangs rgyas dang nas/ spyan drangs/ hūṃ la thim pa las khro bo'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las sangs rgyas dang nas/ tshogs rnams spros te sems can thams cad rdo rje 'jig byed kyi go 'phang la bkod pa dang lhan cig tu 'dus nas rdo rje la thim par gyur/ zhes bshad pa ltar yang rung ste rgya gzhung 'ga' zhig las kyang ngo*/ /gang ltar yang*/ zla ba nyi ma rdo rje hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag /zhal dgu phyag so bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ /zhes dang*/ brel ba'i tshe bsdu na/ sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing*/ khro bo'i nyams thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ /ces pa tsam gyis kyang 'grub ste/

gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs kyi bsnyen pa'i skabs lta bu la dal brel gyi dbang gis thun bzhi la rgyas bsdus gang rung bya ba bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang gzhung ltar bskyed chog rgyas pa byas na legs pas/ khams gsum po za bar nus pa/ /ha ha zhes sgrog cing ljags 'dril ba/ /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa khro gnyer can/ khro gnyer gyi 'gram du smin ma dang spyan 'jig pa'i dus ltar 'bar ba/ /skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la bsdigs mdzub byed pa/ 'jigs pa rnams kyang 'jig par mdzad pa/ phaiṃ ka ra'i sgra chen po 'brug ltar sgrogs pa/ mi'i khrag dang zhag dang rkang dang tshil bu za ba/ 'jigs su rung ba'i thod pa bskam po lngas thod byas shing*/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i thod pa'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ sprul nag po'i mchod phyir thog dang mi rus kyi 'khor lo dang rna cha la sogs pa rus pa'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa/ gsus pa che ba gcer bu'i gzugs can/ mtshan ma gyen du bsgrang ba/ smin ma dang rdzi ma dang sma ra dang ba spu rnams dus ma/ 'i me ltar 'bar zhing*/ rtsa zhal nag po ma he'i gdong can shin tu khros pa/ rwa rnon po can/ de'i steng ma rwa gnyis kyi dbus kyi zhal dmar po rab tu 'jig pa zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa/ de'i steng du 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po yid tsam khros pa/ gzhon nu'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing spyi bor ral pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rwa'i rtsa ba'i g.yas kyi zhal dang po sngon po/ de'i g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal ser po/ rwa'i ra ba'i g.yon gyi zhal dang po dkar po/ de'i g.yas zhal dud kha/ g.yon zhal nag po/ /zhal rnams shin tu khros pa/ zhal dgu po thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa mgo g.yas dang spu phyi bstan te lag pa dang rkang pa'i pags pa g.yon pa nas brkyangs te 'dzin pa/

lhag ma g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug /gnyis pa na bhi dhi pā la/ gsum pa na gtun shing*/ bzhi pa na chu gri lnga pa na ka ṇa ya/ drug pa na dgra sta/ bdun pa na mdung*/ brgyad pa na mnga'/ dgu pa na lcags kyu/ bcu pa na dbyug tho/ /bcu gcig pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bcu gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ bcu gsum ba na rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ bcu bzhi pa na rdo rje tho ba/ bco lnga pa na ral gri /bcu drug pa na cang te'u bsnams shing*/ lhag ma g.yon gyi dang po na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ gnyis pa na tshangs pa'i mgo /gsum pa na phub/ bzhi pa na rkang pa/ lnga pa na zhags pa/ drug pa na gzhu/ bdun pa na rgyu ma/ brgyad pa na dril bu/ dgu pa na lag pa/ bcu pa na dur khrod kyi ras/ /bcu gcig pa na skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/ /bcu gnyis pa na me thab/ /bcu gsum pa na thod tshal/ bcu bzhi pa na sdigs mdzub/ bco lnga pa na 'phan rtse gsum pa/ bcu drug pa na rlung ras bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas kyi dang pos mi/ gnyis pas ma he/ gsum pas glang*/ bzhi pas bong bu/ lnga pas rnga mo/ /drug pas khyi/ /bdun pas lug /brgyad pas wa dang*/ g.yon gyi dang pos bya rgod/ gnyis pas 'ug pa/ gsum pas bya rog /bzhi pas ne tso/ /lnga pas khra/ drug pas bya chen po/ /bdun pas khyim bya/ brgyad pas bzhad mnan pa/ tshangs pa dang dbang po dang khyab 'jug dang drag po dang*/ gzhon nu gdong drug dang log 'dren dang zla ba dang nyi ma rnams kha sbub tu byas te me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ 'dir ni skye ba sprul sku'i lam 'khyer ro/ /rje'i gzhung dang cang 'gya'i der skabs 'dir skye mched byin rlabs mdzad cing*/ paṇa chen gyi der skye mched byin rlabs kyi mjug tu ye shes sems dpa' bskyed par mdzad de mi 'gal yang 'dir snga ma ltar byas na/ de'i mig tu k+ṣiṃ/ rna bar dz+riṃ/ snar khaṃ/ lcer raṃ/ dpral bar kaṃ /lte bar saṃ/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ

thugs kar huṃ/ zhes dang*/ rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa yid tsam khros pa zhes sogs sngar gyi bskyed tshul gnyis gang rung bya/ de'i thugs kar āḥlas byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig mthing ga 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ zhes sems dpa' sum brtsegs bya/ de nas/ oṃ hrīḥha bho ma hā kro dha ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha asmā da pū dza pra ti gṛh+ṇan+tu pra sā da me dhī man ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'i mjug gam/ paṇa chen gyi der sngags de mi snang zhing rgya gzhung 'ga' las kyang ma bshad pa ltar ram/ gang ltar yang*/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥs bgegs bskrad/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tiḥha sogs kyis mchod de/ muṅga ra dzaḥ zhes sogs man gzhung ltar bya ba'am bsdu na/ paṇa chen gyi der dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa dgug gzhug bya bar bshad cing*/ sngags kyi spyan 'dren med par slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ /mchod sngags kyang med par/ khyed rnams ky-is bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas/ shri ye āḥhūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ces bshad pa ltar yang rung ste/ rgya gzhung phal cher las skabs 'di gong 'og tu mchod pa gcig las ma bshad pas sab/ /dbang lhar gsol 'debs byed pa'i tshul gcig ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/

/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis spros pa'i lha mo tsa rtsi ka la sogs pas bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ zhes bsdus nas bya ste gzhan las kyang ngo*/ /de nas mchod pa/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ nas/ spar+sha'i bar ram/ yang na/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥha sogs kyis mchod/ nang mchod ni/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa tsam mo/ /bla brgyud gzhan gang rigs bya/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥ nas hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ chos skyong srung ma rnams dang chos kyi rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong dang klu la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa dang sems can thams cad lhar gyur pa rnam kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te rang gi lus la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥnas hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mgron thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ ces sam/ yang na bcu gsum ma ltar bya zhing 'di'i rgya gzhung phal cher na nang mchod kyi skor mi gsal bas shin tu bsdu na bla ma'i rjes su hrīḥṣ+tīḥs mchod kyang rung ngo*/ /bstod pa ni/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku/ /kun la snyoms mdzad rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /chos kyi dbyings gyur rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ /ye shes sems dpa' rgyal ba kun gyi sras/ /phyag 'tshal 'jam dpal dpal gyur rdzogs pa khyod/ /chos kyi sku la byams sdang mi mnga' yang*/

/srid gsum gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i thabs kyis khro rgyal skur bstan pa/ /'jigs byed gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sam/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos po khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog gtso bo'i gtso/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa gnyis sam gang rung dang*/ bsdu na/ gzugs mchog mas bstod/ dag pa ni paṇa chen gyi de dang rgya gzhung 'ga' zhig na mi snang zhing ma byas kyang rung la/ 'ga' zhig nas 'byung ba ltar byed na/ mtshan ma gyen du bsgreng ba ni bde ba chen po rgyas pa zhes bya zhing gzhan bcu gsum ma ltar ro/ /phreng ba byin rlabs ni rgyun pa'i zhal 'don la nges pa med kyang bsnyen pa'i skabs yin na/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri thod 'dzin par gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar yis mchod la/ gzugs mchog mas bstod nas/ ya mān+ta ka bzla/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'od du zhu ba las mi mgo'i phreng ba'i rnam par gyur/ ces sam/ shin tu bsdu na/ phreng rdog rnams hūṃ las mi mgo'i phreng ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ ces bya'o/ /bzlas pa ni/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ /ya da yo ni ra yak+ṣe ya yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni rā ma ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ ces rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces las sngags dang*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ ces sny-ing po rnams ci 'grub bzla/ mjug tu/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya nas hūṃ phaṭa ces gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya bzlas nas/

oṃ ya māt+na ka ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ nang mchod 'bul zhing*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi zhes sogs dang*/ gzugs mchog ma gang rung gis bstod/ de nas gtor ma 'bul na byin gyis brlabs te/ dam tshig pa bskyed mi bskyed pa'i tshul gnyis las bsdus te bskyed na/ /mdun du skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor phyogs skyong rnams kyi bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ mgron rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dkar po 'od kyi spu gu can du gyur pas gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥnas hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra bhai ra wa ya a dhi pa ti i maṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul nas/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥ sogs kyis mchod pa dang nang mchod 'bul/ gnyis med thun mong zhes sogs kyis bstod/ phyogs skyong rnams skad cig gis 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur/ /phyogs skyong rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje zhes sogs brjod de/ rtsa sngags tshar gcig gi rjes su/ oṃ bhu tsa ra naṃ/ zhes pa nas/ bhu te bh+yaḥ zhes pa gsum gyis bsngo/ /oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ /da sha sogs kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags te nang mchod phul nas/ bcom ldan chos rje 'jam dbyangs nas/ de'i bar chad zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /ces 'phrin las bcol/ /las gshin la gtor 'bul bsdus pa byed na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas las kyi gshin rje yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/

ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ kā la rū pa sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyi phul nas/ 'jam dpal bka' nyan mas bstod/ chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gi bar gcod zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /de nas gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya bzlas nas/ ma rnyed yongs su zhes sogs kyis bzod gsol byas te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron gyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ /dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim/ mgron gzhan rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces bya/ rnam dag bsam pas sogs kyi smon lam gdab/ nyer bsdu ni/ dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang la thim/ zhes pa nas/ mi dmigs par gyur/ ces dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ /mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ zhes sam/ yang na/ de'i mig tu k+ṣiṃ/ zhes sogs dang*/ de nas shis brjod bya'o// /yang gzhal yas khang med par bskyed tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' re snang yang gcig ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lta bu'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ nang mchod sogs/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥs bsangs/ /swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa so so'i nang du mchod pa rnams khyad par gsum ldan dang nang mchod dang gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ las khro bo rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog mthing nag zhes pa nas/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal nas rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar āḥlas byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nas/ 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de'i mig gnyis su k+ṣīṃ/ nas/ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ ya mān+ta kas nang mchod dbul/ gzugs mchog mas bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas sngags phreng la thim par gyur/ bar bsams la/ sngags gsum ci 'grub dang*/ yig brgya bzla/ gtor 'bul ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ /ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka i daṃ ba ling ta kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing*/ nang mchod kyang dbul/ sngar ltar bstod/ ma rnyed ces sogs kyi bzod gsol byas nas/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang*/ zhes sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na/

oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ dge ba 'di yis zhes sogs kyi bsngo smon bya'o/ /zhes 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtog gtor 'bul dang bcas pa'i ngag 'don bsdus pa'i rim pa brjod pa 'di ni/ co ne'i dpon gyi gdung rgyud du 'khrungs shing dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i dpon os lā+au ye shes blo bzang dpal 'byor zhes bya bas kho bos 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gi mngon rtogs rgyas pa ma lcogs pa'i tshe/ bsdus pa bya tshul zhig gyis zhes gsung gis bskul ba'i ngo bor/ khri zur bshad sgrub ming can gyis dpa' gcig gi mngon rtog zhig sngar byas zin kyang 'dir slar yang don gnyer shes 'dod can gzhan re gnyis la'ang phan cher bsdus pa byed tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig rnam grangs su bkod nas co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub po// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa'i rnam grangs brjod pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 162-- PAGE 163- -PAGE 161-
